summary: Completed comprehensive testing of User Management in Settings Page feature. All requested features tested successfully. Settings page now has 3 tabs (Général, Utilisateurs, SMTP). User management moved from separate /users page to Settings > Utilisateurs tab. Contact card form and sheet working correctly.

issues: Console warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby` for {DialogContent} - accessibility improvement

passed_tests: Settings page loads with 3 tabs: Général, Utilisateurs, SMTP
Utilisateurs tab shows client users table with columns: Utilisateur, Fonction, Rôle, Statut, Actions
Client select dropdown works (OHMCARE LAB auto-selected)
Search input present for filtering users
'Nouvel utilisateur' button opens CreateUserDialog
CreateUserDialog shows contact card form with sections: IDENTITÉ, PROFESSIONNEL, ACCÈS, Observations
Form fields present: Nom complet*, Email*, Téléphone, Fonction, Service, Rôle*, Mot de passe*, Observations
Email validation: submitting with invalid email shows 'Email invalide' error
Required fields validation: empty name shows 'Nom requis', empty email shows 'Email requis', empty password shows 'Mot de passe requis'
Create new user with valid data succeeds and user appears in table with contact fields
Click on user row opens UserContactSheet (slide panel)
UserContactSheet shows 'Fiche de contact' card with: Nom complet, Email, Téléphone, Fonction, Service, Observations
UserContactSheet has 'Modifier' button for editing fields
UserContactSheet has 'Rôle & Accès' section with role selector and active toggle
UserContactSheet has 'Réinitialiser le mot de passe' button
/users URL redirects to /settings
Sidebar no longer has separate 'Users' link - merged into Settings
Backend: GET /api/clients/{client_id}/users returns users with contact fields
Backend: POST /api/clients/{client_id}/users creates user with all contact fields
Backend: PATCH /api/client-users/{id} updates role, status, and contact fields
Backend: DELETE /api/client-users/{id} removes user from client
Backend: POST /api/client-users/{id}/reset-password resets password successfully
critical_code_review_comments: CreateUserDialog correctly validates email format with regex and shows 'Email invalide' error
Form validation shows appropriate error messages for all required fields
UserContactSheet allows inline editing of contact fields with 'Modifier' button
Role selector in sheet directly updates via PATCH API
Password reset endpoint properly hashes new password and verifies login works
Contact fields (phone, job_title, department, notes) stored on user document and enriched in list_client_users response
Minor accessibility issue: DialogContent missing Description prop - does not affect functionality
seed_data_creation: Created test user 'Test User Playwright' during testing (cleaned up after). Backend tests create/delete TEST_* prefixed users.
